title: Run the theme audit on demand: render every block on every theme, score it and keep a baseline of the holes

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Productionise the 2026-10-28 harness (project folder theme-cohesion/harness): render matrix, coverage JSON, contact sheets, baseline that can only shrink. Real-content fixture first, because default props hide some blocks. Shipped: pnpm audit:themes (scripts/theme-audit.mjs, render matrix in scripts/theme-audit/render.audit.tsx) renders every block in the page-editor config on all nine skins with a schema-driven real-content fixture (lib/theme-audit/fixture.ts), writes coverage.json, and with --sheets shoots contact sheets per palette category. docs/design-systems/theme-cohesion/baseline.json lists every block-on-theme hole under 0.9 coverage; a new hole fails the audit and --update-baseline refuses to add one.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
